title: Dependency Catalyst: runway, risk burnup, and cross-team ownership playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: As initiatives scale across Eng/Design/Security/Infra, we lack a lightweight, versioned artifact that tracks dependency readiness, ownership, and risk over a cycle. Existing spreadsheets and ad-hoc Slack threads create ambiguity at cutover. Goal: Ship a 'Dependency Catalyst'—a concise runway model + risk burnup dashboard + playbook that (1) standardizes how teams declare and accept dependencies, (2) surfaces high-risk items early, and (3) provides automated handoff/escalation channels. This ticket is the PM-level plan to define scope, success metrics, and delivery steps for the MVP (console + Linear integrations + Slack signals).
acceptance_criteria: Dependency schema defined and agreed by Eng/Design/Security/Infra leads
Linear integration: dependencies can be linked to parent initiatives and display status/owner in a shared view
Runway view in Console that shows dependency stage (Intake/Committed/Ready/Cutover) and a rolling risk burnup chart
Escalation policy implemented as Slack alerts + auto-created Linear blockers when risk crosses thresholds
>80% of critical-dependencies for current cycle have owners assigned and target dates

PM: Run two-cycle pilot with Platform and Console teams (Cycle 2026-W07 and 2026-W09)
PM/Eng: Implement Slack alerting rules and auto-blocker flows (Due: 2026-02-10)

kpis: Percent of critical dependencies with owner assigned by cycle start >= 80%
Mean time-to-resolution for dependency blockers <= 4 business days
Percentage of releases with at least one unresolved critical dependency <= 5%
Pilot adoption: 2 teams actively using runway view for at least 2 cycles
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams resist extra process -> Mitigation: keep schema minimal (5 fields) and optional enforcement only for 'critical' flag
Risk: Privacy/Security objections to sharing dependency details -> Mitigation: support sensitivity tag and role-based visibility in Console
Risk: Linear integration scope creep -> Mitigation: start with read-only linking + webhooks and iterate on write flows later
Risk: Duplicate signals (spreadsheets vs runway) -> Mitigation: migration guide and automation to import existing lists
